review_description: Dealing with Green Energy was easy, everything was explained to me in an easily understood way.The installer was punctual and his work was neat and tidy.

I felt pressured into signing the contract and sign up with Brighte for interest free payments.After thinking about this I realised that I did not need what they wanted me to install so I contacted them and asked to terminate the contract which they said something incoherent to me, this was two days after signing the contract.I contacted them on the next day in their website and asked for the contract to be terminated and for them to notify me when it has been done.3 days later I rang them again asking the same only to be fobbed offIn regards to Brighte I rang them and asked for a termination and the carried this out within 1 dayI am still in the cooling off period of 10 days
Sales people were punctual and helpful.Installation went smooth and on timeThey rang the next day to check on the job not to chase moneyThey installed extras at no extra cost
Very happy with installation and overall process.  We added battery after 2 years but to maximize the benefits, add battery with solar system.

Kevin is the owner and installer and not just a salesman. He was easy to speak with and answered all my questions even offering alternative points of view. He matched my best price and the install was done quickly and efficiently.
Quick installation and easy to deal with. Good follow up.

The first installation was on-time, neat, and tidy.  They handled everything with the energy retailer.  System was up and going.  Energy monitoring program was working.After running for two weeks, Solar production was less than expected.  I complained.  They sent out a service man who checked things out, and confirmed the system was as they expected.Still not good.  Complained again - twice.  Upon request, sent in a detailed complaint with diary.  They sent another service guy out.  He indicated the system was not producing as expected, and arranged to have it fixed.The service guy changed the inverter, and added 4 panels to the roof.Looks better now.  Still too cloudy to get a solid feel.

The quoting process was very easy. Especially as we are in regional NSW.  Phone and email contact made it clear and straightforward. All questions were answered in a clear and concise manner.The installation was fantastic,  the guys were professional, punctual and extremely tidy. Even fixing a small pre existing problem we had on the roof while they were up there. Once again taking time to explain the system and answer any questions we had.The customer service has been top notch, they have made sure we have everything we need to get up and running.
The installation occurred in 3 days of signing up where as the other companies through solar quotes were taking 6-8 weeks. Same panels and inverters were more than double the price.

Quote was received within 24 hours of first request and improved the system they first offered after a phone discussion. Ann on the admin side was most helpful any time we spoke. Team of tradies arrived on the day promised and spent a full day on the install. When they finished they explained how the equipment functioned and installed my phone app so I could monitor my FIT. Although a couple of cement tiles were broken, they came back a week later and fitted the new tiles I had found. Cleaned up the mess after their work both times. All together I found them a professional team to deal with.

I purchased a Solar system over 5 years ago and my inverter is already broken. I requested that Green Energy replace the inverter (as in I have to purchase a new one) and they insisted that I pay upfront for the new inverter. That was over 3 months ago and I have been calling them every week sometimes 3 times a week to get them to come and replace my inverter that I have already paid for. I keep getting through to either an answering service who advises me someone will call me back or to a Philippines call centre where again they apologise and say someone will call me. So basically DO NOT PAY for anything upfront until you have an appointment and the guy is at your house ! After care service is obviously awful.
Those installer were really good, they done their job very well.  And it save us a lot of money.
I would recommend them as they are quick in arranging installations and not as slow as some much higher rated suppliers
Too early to say. Installation yesterday, not operational yet.

I would  like to thank you for the people you sent they were all very professional and very quick to come for quotes. The main reason we went with The Green Energy Shop was because they were local. I knew nothing about solar power before the three people you suggested came to talk to us and they helped enormously.
